message: "Bash(pnpm test:*)" appears in both permissions.allow and permissions.deny in .claude/settings.json; deny wins, so the allow is dead - remove one side.

"Bash(rm -rf tmp/*)" in permissions.allow pre-approves a destructive command while a PreToolUse hook matches Bash in .claude/settings.json; hooks run regardless of allows - drop the allow or align it with the hook.
CLAUDE.md imports @.claude/rules/style.md, which is not in the workspace inventory; fix the path or create the file (dangling reference).
CLAUDE.md references subagent_type "releaser", but no such agent exists under .claude/agents/ (dangling reference); fix the name or add the agent.
